Alejandra (CEO): Morning team — quick Friday bulletin: three priorities for next week. 1) EU Private GA: keep launch window but tighten rollback criteria. 2) Latency: p95 is still above target on long tails. 3) Cost/unit: hit -8% by Q1 through batching + quant rules. Short, please react with owners. :rocket:
Matt (VP Product): Noted. I'll own EU GA canary and rollback checklist. Proposing schema freeze by Tue 09:00 PT. @Ravi can you confirm infra availability for the canary?
Ravi (VP Eng): Yup. Reallocating 2 infra SREs for canary windows and a small latency sprint. Plan posted here in 2h. Quick runplan: ```- Day0: smoke + canary (small % traffic)
- Day1: expand if no errors
- Day2: ramp to GA or rollback```
Claudia (Head of Ops): Support rota updated, oncall overlap at the start of the canary. I'll coordinate NOC and customer success comms. Link to rota: https://intranet/redwood/rota (internal).
Matt (VP Product): For metrics, can we present: current p50/p95/p99, cost per 1k tokens, and error rate for the canary slice in the dashboard? Need that in the Monday readout.
Ravi (VP Eng): Will add these to the dashboard. Current snapshot: p50 32ms, p95 138ms, p99 410ms. Cost/1k tokens: $0.42. Error rate (5xx): 0.4%. Targets: p95 <= 95ms, cost/1k <= $0.38, 5xx <= 0.25%.
Alejandra (CEO): Good. Two behavioral asks: 1) prefer conservative rollouts (canary -> burst -> GA) 2) if metric regression >10% at any stage, stop and escalate. Use Slack incident channel and ping me + @Matt + @Ravi.
incidents-bot: Deploy event: deploy-2024-11-01-17:12 by matt.prod — canary scheduled 2024-11-04 16:00 UTC.
Claudia (Head of Ops): I'll schedule a 15m pre-launch sync 30m before canary start and a 30m post-canary readout. Adding recordings to the canary doc.
Matt (VP Product): One more ask: keep the customer-facing feature notes minimal for GA; we can iterate on console improvements after stability is confirmed.
Ravi (VP Eng): Acknowledged. We'll gate cosmetic migrations. Also running a quick profiler sweep tonight to see hot kernels; will share findings.
Alejandra (CEO): Thanks all. Small wins: retention metric ticked +3% MoM on onboarding flow — shout out to growth and infra for stability there. We'll do a short all-hands Monday to surface canary results and next steps. Meeting: Mon 10:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
